raw_text: User clicked link in email from spoofed-hr@company-benefits.xyz claiming to require immediate password reset. Link redirects to credential harvesting page mimicking company SSO portal.
47 failed SSH login attempts from IP 198.51.100.23 targeting root account over 12-minute window. IP geolocated to known VPS hosting provider.
Employee uploaded 340MB archive containing customer PII to personal Google Drive. File includes SSN and credit card fields from CRM export.
Service account credentials found in public GitHub repository. Account has read access to production Cloud SQL database containing customer records.
Employee on performance improvement plan accessed confidential M&A documents and board meeting minutes 47 times in past 24 hours, outside normal access patterns.
Executable dropper detected on workstation. Process spawned PowerShell with encoded command downloading payload from known C2 domain evil-update.xyz.
Bulk phishing campaign detected: 200+ employees received identical email impersonating IT department requesting MFA token reset via malicious link.
Automated credential stuffing attack against customer login portal. 12,000 unique username/password combinations attempted from rotating proxy IPs in 30-minute window.
Unusual S3 bucket access: 2.1GB of customer data downloaded via API from IP not associated with any known employee or service. Bucket contains billing records.
Admin account logged in from two countries within 15 minutes: New York (US) and Lagos (NG). Impossible travel detected. Session from Lagos changed 3 user permissions.
Recently terminated employee's VPN credentials used to access internal file server 6 hours after account should have been disabled. Downloaded engineering design documents.
Ransomware behavior detected: rapid file encryption across network shares. 450 files encrypted with .locked extension in 3 minutes. Process originated from email attachment.
CEO impersonation email sent to CFO requesting urgent wire transfer of $285,000 to new vendor account. Email passed SPF but failed DKIM. Reply-to address differs from sender.
Distributed brute force attack targeting Office 365 accounts. Low-and-slow pattern: 2-3 attempts per account per hour across 500+ accounts from 50 IPs.
Database administrator ran SELECT * on production customer table and exported 50,000 records to CSV on local machine. No change ticket or business justification found.
OAuth token for third-party analytics app compromised. Token has read access to all Google Workspace user emails. Unusual API calls detected from Eastern European IP.
Cryptominer process detected on development server. CPU usage spiked to 95% running xmrig binary. Process was installed via compromised npm package in CI pipeline.
Employee in finance department accessed 12 colleagues' salary records and compensation packages over the weekend. Access is technically permitted by role but usage pattern is anomalous.
DNS exfiltration detected: workstation making thousands of DNS queries to subdomain.evil-dns.com with encoded data in subdomain labels. Queries average 200 bytes of data each.
Employee forwarded 3 months of internal strategy documents to personal email address. Documents include unreleased product roadmap and competitive analysis marked confidential.
